cases.question: 根据库中的合同政策，员工跨国搬迁或更换合同时，一定要重新经历新地区的试用期吗？免除重新试用需要同时满足什么条件？
required_points: 不一定；在GitLab任职连续未中断，且已通过原地区或原合同的试用期时，无需重新试用
failure_conditions: 遗漏主问题的必要条件或例外
把建议或可能性说成必然，或把强制要求说成可选
用其他事项的相同数字或系统名称代替本题依据

evidence.heading_path: Contracts, Background Screenings, Probation Periods & PIAA → Probation Period
evidence.quote: In case of relocation to a different country or change of contract, if a team member has continued service with GitLab (tenure with GitLab has been uninterrupted) and they have already passed the probationary period of their original location or contract, they do not need to go through the probation period of their new location or contract.

evidence_groups.requirement: 持续任职且已通过原试用期，两项同时成立

alternatives.heading_path: Contracts, Background Screenings, Probation Periods & PIAA → Probation Period
alternatives.quote: In case of relocation to a different country or change of contract, if a team member has continued service with GitLab (tenure with GitLab has been uninterrupted) and they have already passed the probationary period of their original location or contract, they do not need to go through the probation period of their new location or contract.

alternatives.heading_path: Relocation → How To Apply for a Long-Term Relocation → Contract Phase → Relocation to a New Country → Tasks for People Operations
alternatives.quote: - [Probation Period](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/contracts-probation-periods/#probation-period): If a team member has continued service with GitLab (tenure with GitLab has been uninterrupted) and they have already passed the probationary period of their original location or contract, they do not need to go through the probation period of their new location or contract.

required_points: 基本工资为年度保证工资
variable pay目标不保证实际支付，随结果可高可低
股权需董事会批准才最终确定

evidence.heading_path: Compensation at Gitlab → Compensation Elements → Base Salary
evidence.quote: Base salary is annual guaranteed pay, typically paid in local currency. It’s determined by role, level, and location, and forms the foundation of total compensation.

evidence.heading_path: Compensation at Gitlab → Compensation Elements → Variable Pay
evidence.quote: Some roles include variable pay in addition to base salary. Variable pay has a target amount, but is not guaranteed. The target amount represents what a team member would earn if performance targets are met. Actual payment can be higher or lower depending on results.

Note: All stock options and RSU grants are subject to approval by the Board of Directors and no grants are final until such approval has been made. The Company reserves the right in its own determination to make any adjustments to stock option grants at its sole discretion including the decision not to make a grant at all.
